# Northwest Bail Bonds

Northwest Bail Bonds is a Billings-based Bail Bond company serving all 56 Montana counties. The direct phone line, (406) 601-1225, is answered 24 hours a day. Email inquiries can be sent to northwestbailbond@gmail.com. The company grew through relationships across Montana and helps callers handle the Bond in front of them and what comes next.

## Important boundaries

Northwest Bail Bonds can explain the Bail Bond agreement and process. It does not provide legal advice, guarantee an exact release time, guarantee a legal outcome, or make a case-specific eligibility decision through the website. Montana producer licensing should be verified through the Commissioner of Securities and Insurance.
